GetPostgresqlSlowLogTemplate.start: Query start time in UTC format, e.g., 2023-06-01T00:00:00Z
GetPostgresqlSlowLogTemplate.end: Query end time in UTC format, e.g., 2023-06-02T00:00:00Z
GetPostgresqlSlowLogTemplate.fingerprintMd5: MD5 value of the normalized SQL fingerprint
GetPostgresqlSlowLogTemplate.orderBy: Sort field, default is durationCount. Supported sort fields: executeTimes (execution count), durationSum (total execution time), durationMax (maximum execution time), durationMin (minimum execution time), durationAvg (average execution time)
GetPostgresqlSlowLogTemplate.order: Sort direction, either asc or desc, default is desc
